Subject: Post-call recap + last-week asks (pilot timeline & owners)

Samantha / Tom — great call this morning, thanks for the time. Quick recap and three asks as the quarter wraps up: 

Recap (from our discovery)
- Pilot: 8-week pilot to validate inference latency/cost for transaction enrichment (approx 2M tokens/day).
- Success metrics: 95th pctl latency < 250ms and sub-$0.004/token on average across peak windows.
- Constraints: Data residency in us-west, SOC 2 evidence required, procurement review in your finance lane.

Three asks before the week closes: 
1) Budget owner: please confirm the person who owns budget approval (name & email).
2) Legal/procurement contact: who will own the purchase order / contract redline?
3) Target pilot kickoff: is week of Dec 7 still realistic, or do you need a short delay?

Attached: draft SLA and a short mutual action plan showing milestones and signoffs. I flagged items where we expect to be flexible (e.g., data retention windows) vs. non-negotiable (region/controls).

If you prefer, Marissa can run a 20-minute sync with your procurement/legal and our legal to speed approvals.

Thanks — marking this as time-sensitive for the week.

— Markus
Markus Klein
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Quick answers: 
- Budget owner: Tom Becker (CFO) will sign off on budget for Q4 pilots (tom.becker@glacierpay.com).

- Timeline: Dec 7 start is still our target, but I want to confirm after the legal review completes. Can you hold the week open?

If you can send an updated mutual action plan with the expected legal review checklist, that would help.

Best,

I'll get Linda and Tom on a 15-minute call if you want to hash final language. Otherwise we'll proceed with the PO once Tom signs.
